analysis.call: set.seed(2026) # learner_data is the local CSV data frame analysis_columns <- c("hp", "wt", "mpg", "label") source_rows <- which(complete.cases(learner_data[analysis_columns])) analysis_data <- learner_data[source_rows, analysis_columns, drop = FALSE] labels <- as.character(analysis_data[["label"]]) fit <- lm(reformulate(c("hp", "wt"), response = "mpg"), data = analysis_data) evidence <- as_rlearnxr_evidence(fit, labels = labels)
